description: This file defines a REST controller named VehicleController in a Spring Boot application. It handles HTTP requests related to vehicle management, such as adding a new vehicle and retrieving all vehicles. The class interacts with a VehicleService to perform business logic operations.

classes.name: VehicleController
classes.description: A REST controller for managing vehicles, providing endpoints to add a vehicle and retrieve all vehicles.

methods.name: addVehicle
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new vehicle, receiving VehicleRequest data and returning the response from the VehicleService.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all vehicles.
